article_content: A 31-year-old Bronx woman, Erika Menendez, faces second-degree murder charges as a hate crime. Queens prosecutors allege she shoved 46-year-old Sunando Sen onto subway tracks, resulting in his death.  According to the prosecutor's statement, Menendez confessed, stating, 'I pushed a Muslim off the train tracks because I hate Hindus and Muslims ever since 2001 when they put down the twin towers I've been beating them up.' Sen, a graphic designer, was raised in a Hindu family. Witnesses reported seeing Menendez pacing and talking to herself before the incident. Security footage shows someone fleeing the scene; Menendez was identified through a lineup and a 911 call from a witness who recognized her. District Attorney Richard A. Brown called the act 'every subway commuter's worst nightmare' and highlighted the hateful nature of the alleged crime. Menendez's legal representation remains unclear.  A similar incident, the murder of Ki-Suck Han in Times Square, is mentioned for context.

article_content: The original Batmobile, built in 1966 by George Barris from a 1955 Lincoln Futura purchased for $1, is going up for auction for the first time.  Barris, now 87,  transformed the car over 15 days and $15,000 into the iconic vehicle seen in the legendary Batman TV series. Barrett Jackson will auction the Batmobile on January 19th in Scottsdale, Arizona. While the reserve price is undisclosed, both the auction house and Barris expect it to sell for 'multiple millions'.  The Batmobile, featuring a V8 engine and automatic transmission, boasts an unmistakable design and storied history, making it highly attractive to collectors.  Comparable vehicles, such as Sean Connery's Aston Martin DB5 from 'Goldfinger' and Steve McQueen's Ford GT40 from 'Le Mans', have sold for millions at auction.  Barris stated, 'I think it is the most valuable car in the world... I would like someone else to enjoy it now.' Craig Jackson, CEO of Barrett-Jackson, added that the Batmobile is 'true Americana' and the 'only one to have been on the Batman series.'

'
A new study reveals that four dozen Antarctic ice shelves have shrunk significantly since 1997.  Twenty-eight of these crucial ice shelves, which act as buffers between glaciers and the ocean, have lost more than half their ice.  The study, published in Science Advances, analyzed 162 ice shelves, finding that 68 experienced substantial shrinkage between 1997 and 2021, while 29 grew and 62 remained unchanged.  The melting ice contributes to rising sea levels and alters ocean salinity, raising concerns about the long-term consequences of climate change.  The Amundsen Sea region is highlighted as particularly critical for sea level rise.  The study details massive iceberg calving events as a major factor, along with melting from warm underwater currents.  Overall, Antarctic ice shelves lost approximately 8.3 trillion tons of ice over the 25-year period, with significant losses observed in several key locations, such as the Wordie ice shelf (87% mass loss since 1997) and the Thwaites ice shelf (70% mass loss, approximately 4.1 trillion tons). While ice shelves in the eastern part of the continent showed some growth, the western side experienced far more substantial ice loss.  Although direct attribution to human-caused climate change remains challenging, the ongoing ice shelf decline aligns with warming global temperatures.
'

article_content: Activists from Sea Shepherd have released images allegedly showing three dead minke whales on the deck of a Japanese whaling vessel within the Southern Ocean Whale Sanctuary, a protected zone. Bob Brown of Sea Shepherd described the scene as ‘gruesome’ and ‘medieval.’ This incident occurred during the annual whaling season. Sea Shepherd claims to have documented the Japanese Nisshin Maru operating inside the sanctuary, violating the international moratorium on commercial whaling. Japan maintains its whaling is for ‘scientific research,’ citing a 1946 treaty. The organization alleges that a fourth whale was also being processed on board. The clash between anti-whaling activists and Japanese whaling vessels has escalated over the years, with documented instances of ships colliding and protesters boarding vessels. New Zealand’s foreign minister, Murray McCully, while condemning the whaling, stated it occurred in international waters outside New Zealand’s jurisdiction. He reiterated New Zealand’s call for Japan to end its whaling program. Japan’s fisheries agency defended its actions, claiming adherence to an IWC-approved research plan. The Japanese foreign ministry asserted that its research whaling is a legitimate right under international law. Captain Peter Hammarstedt of the Sea Shepherd ship Bob Barker accused Japan of blatant disregard for international law. Australia has brought a case against Japan to the International Court of Justice challenging the legality of its research whaling program. Australia is conducting surveillance flights over the Southern Ocean to monitor the situation. However, Sea Shepherd reports that these surveillance flights are yet to be observed.

article_content: A Belgian research team investigated whether a woman's walk reveals if she regularly experiences orgasms during intercourse.  The researchers at the Universiti Catholique de Louvain studied videos of women walking.  They discovered sexologists could accurately determine, better than chance alone, if a woman regularly had orgasms from intercourse, based solely on her walking style.  The researchers theorize that this is because orgasms might influence muscle groups, potentially impacting gait.  This aligns with research indicating a connection between vaginal orgasms and improved mental well-being.  Interestingly, the study found no such correlation between gait and clitoral orgasms.  Key gait characteristics like pelvic rotation, vertebral rotation, and stride length seemed to differentiate women who experience vaginal orgasms from intercourse.  The researchers suggest that a walk exhibiting fluidity, energy, and a lack of muscle tension might indicate regular vaginal orgasms from intercourse. This research contributes to our understanding of the impact of sexual function on overall physical expression and might provide valuable insights for sex therapy.

article_content: 'Alexander Levy claimed victory at the Portugal Masters after heavy rain forced the tournament's reduction to 36 holes at the Oceanico Victoria Golf Club. Initially shortened to 54 holes due to Thursday and Friday downpours, the final round was cut short on Sunday. Levy, playing alongside Nicolas Colsaerts, had completed only one hole of the final round when play was suspended. The 36-hole scores determined the final results. Levy, a French golfer, secured his second European Tour win, adding to his April victory at the Volvo China Open. Speaking to Sky Sports 4, Levy expressed his surprise and joy, stating, 'It feels very special. If you'd told me at the start of the year I'd win two tournaments, I'd have said never!' He attributed his success to hard work and strong play. Levy's second round completion on Friday meant he didn't play on Saturday. He described winning after only two rounds as 'special,' emphasizing his focus on the final round. The final leaderboard shows Levy (124), Colsaerts (127), Aguilar and Madsen tied for third (129), and several others tied for sixth and eighth. Levy plans to compete in the World Matchplay in Kent next week, before the Race to Dubai concludes. Colsaerts finished three shots behind Levy, while Aguilar, Madsen, and Wattel trailed further. Only four players finished the final round. Tournament Director Jose Maria Zamora explained that the unexpected heavy downpours, despite a favorable forecast, led to the decision to shorten the tournament. He cited concerns for sponsors and the scheduling of upcoming tournaments in Hong Kong.'

article_content: Ed Miliband's speech outlining Labour's immigration policy lasted 7 minutes and 43 seconds, sparking criticism of his approach.  In Great Yarmouth, he pledged to jail bosses exploiting cheap foreign labor, introduce stricter entry/exit checks, limit in-work benefits for EU migrants, and extend the waiting period for out-of-work benefits.  However, a leaked party document instructed activists to avoid the topic if raised by voters.  Miliband called the document ‘not very well drafted’ but insisted Labour takes immigration seriously. He emphasized responding to public concerns about immigration's impact, stating that such worry is ‘understandable.’  He also aimed to end exploitation of migrant workers.  The leaked document suggested shifting the conversation away from immigration, a strategy criticized by some Labour MPs who noted real-world concerns about immigration's impact on areas like healthcare, housing, and crime.  A poll showed strong public support for limiting EU migrants.  Conservative MP Julian Smith criticized Miliband's brief speech, calling it a sign of weak leadership.

article_content: Concerns are mounting in South Australia over dangerously substandard plumbing work, prompting a crisis meeting between industry representatives and the state's consumer protection agency. The Plumbing Industry Association of South Australia has highlighted numerous cases of what it calls 'predatory practices,' posing serious risks to homeowners. Reports in the association's magazine and The Advertiser feature examples such as sinks draining into toilets and exposed gas pipes. Paul Worthington, the association's membership manager, emphasizes that this poor workmanship not only damages the industry's reputation but also creates costly and potentially life-threatening situations for consumers. He cited specific examples, including exposed copper gas pipes—which should be buried at least 300mm underground—as well as instances where plumbers have cut corners to save money, effectively defrauding their clients. The Advertiser also published photos illustrating other examples of shoddy work, including strangely designed toilets and taps that don't reach sinks. Worthington states the problem has been worsening for nine years, despite his efforts to raise awareness.  He says that the current self-regulation system is failing, with a significant majority of association members calling for increased oversight and enforcement of existing rules. Contributing factors, he adds, include low plumber income, increased material costs, and a shortage of inspectors. The upcoming meeting will involve key stakeholders across the housing and building industries, to address the widespread problems. The Commissioner for Consumer Affairs has yet to respond to requests for comment.

article_content: Vladimir Putin’s opponents are questioning the size of a pike he claims to have caught while on holiday in Siberia.  Photos show the 60-year-old president in camouflage fatigues, displaying the fish.  Critics suggest the fish’s size is exaggerated.  The Kremlin reported the pike weighed 46lbs (21kg), a figure disputed by critics who estimate it to be only 10-11kg.  One journalist noted a pike of that weight would sink.  Putin’s spokesman, Dmitry Peskov, dismissed the criticism as summer boredom.  He claimed to have witnessed the weighing.  The pro-Kremlin newspaper, Komsomolskaya Pravda, published numerous pictures and a video of Putin's Siberian trip.  Previous staged events involving Putin, such as a Black Sea artifact discovery and a stork migration event, have been revealed. While Putin maintains high approval ratings, his authority was impacted by 2011-2012 protests.

'
BENGALURU:  Residents of Pillanna Garden and Sagayapura in east Bengaluru’s Pulikeshinagar, facing irregular water supply for years, can expect relief soon.  Two agencies often blamed for the city’s civic issues – the Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB) and the Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP) – are collaborating to address this. BWSSB plans to build a water tank at Pillanna Garden playground.  The BBMP has allocated 1,760 square meters of land, though ownership won’t be transferred.  BWSSB engineers will survey the site to determine whether an underground or overhead tank is feasible.  The project’s completion will take several months. BBMP Chief Commissioner Tushar Giri Nath confirmed the permission.  Issued on November 16, the BBMP’s permission letter stipulates the use of modern construction techniques to minimize disruption.  The water shortage began three years ago after an existing tank was demolished for a Namma Metro station. Water was rerouted from nearby tanks to mitigate supply disruptions to areas like Fraser Town, Maruthi Sevanagar, DJ Halli, Bagalur Layout, and SK Garden. Akhanda Srinivasa Murthy, former Pulikeshinagar MLA, welcomed the project, stating that he had repeatedly highlighted the need for a new water tank in the assembly.'

خبر خوش برای ساکنان منطقه پولیکشیناگر در شرق بنگلور! مشکل کم آبی مناطق پیلانا گاردن و ساگایاپورا که سال‌هاست گریبان‌گیر مردم بوده است، به‌زودی حل خواهد شد. دو سازمان که اغلب به دلیل مشکلات شهری مورد سرزنش قرار می‌گیرند، یعنی هیئت آب و فاضلاب بنگلور (BWSSB) و شهرداری بزرگ بنگلور (BBMP)، برای حل این مشکل همکاری می‌کنند.  BWSSB قصد دارد یک مخزن آب در زمین بازی پیلانا گاردن بسازد.  BBMP 1760 متر مربع زمین اختصاص داده است، هرچند مالکیت آن منتقل نخواهد شد. مهندسان BWSSB محل را بررسی می‌کنند تا مشخص کنند که ساخت مخزن زیرزمینی یا مخزن هوایی مناسب‌تر است.  تکمیل این پروژه چند ماه طول خواهد کشید.  توشار گیری نات، کمیسر ارشد BBMP، این مجوز را تأیید کرده است. نامه مجوز BBMP که در تاریخ 16 نوامبر صادر شده است، استفاده از فناوری‌های مدرن در ساخت مخزن برای به حداقل رساندن اختلال را الزامی کرده است. کمبود آب سه سال پیش پس از تخریب مخزن موجود برای ساخت ایستگاه متروی ناما آغاز شد. آب از مخازن نزدیک برای کاهش اختلال در تأمین آب به مناطق اطراف مانند فرزر تاون، ماروتی سواناگر، دی جی هالی، باغالور لی‌آوت و اس.ک. گاردن هدایت شد. اکhanda Srinivasa Murthy، نماینده پیشین پولیکشیناگر، از این پروژه استقبال کرد و گفت که بارها در مجلس به ضرورت ساخت مخزن آب جدید اشاره کرده است.'

article_content: Spanish artist Lesia Trubat has ingeniously transformed traditional pointe shoes into digital paintbrushes.  Collaborating with Lilypad Arduino, she developed a system that tracks a ballerina’s every movement—pliés, points, arabesques—and translates them into abstract digital art via a custom smartphone app.  This innovative technology, integrated directly into the shoes, records the dancer’s pressure and movement, sending signals to the app, which then creates visual representations.  Trubat’s ‘E-Traces’ project allows dancers to analyze their movements, comparing them to others and fostering self-improvement.  The resulting ‘motion graphs’ vary based on the movements and their precision.  While currently focused on ballet, Trubat envisions broader applications across various dance forms, from self-teaching tools to live performance visualizations.  This builds on her previous ‘Traces, memories of dance’ project, which used ink and salt to capture movement.  Trubat, captivated by dance’s ephemeral nature, aims to preserve its fleeting beauty through these technological innovations.
translated_content: هنرمند اسپانیایی، لسیا تروبات، به طور خلاقانه‌ای کفش‌های پوانت سنتی را به قلم‌های نقاشی دیجیتال تبدیل کرده است. او با همکاری Lilypad Arduino، سیستمی را توسعه داده است که هر حرکت بالرین را - pliés، points، arabesques - ردیابی کرده و آنها را از طریق یک برنامه تلفن هوشمند سفارشی به هنر دیجیتال انتزاعی تبدیل می‌کند. این فناوری نوآورانه که مستقیماً در کفش‌ها تعبیه شده است، فشار و حرکت رقصنده را ثبت کرده و سیگنال‌هایی را به برنامه می‌فرستد که سپس نمایش‌های بصری ایجاد می‌کند.  پروژهٔ ‘E-Traces’ تروبات به رقصندگان اجازه می‌دهد تا حرکات خود را تجزیه و تحلیل کنند، آنها را با دیگران مقایسه کنند و به خودسازی کمک کنند. نمودارهای حرکتی حاصل، بسته به حرکات و دقت آن‌ها، متفاوت است. در حالی که در حال حاضر بر روی باله تمرکز دارد، تروبات کاربردهای گسترده‌تری را در اشکال مختلف رقص، از ابزارهای خودآموزی تا تجسم‌های اجرای زنده، پیش‌بینی می‌کند. این پروژه بر روی پروژه قبلی او، ‘Traces, memories of dance’ (ردپاها، خاطرات رقص)، بنا شده است که از جوهر و نمک برای ثبت حرکت استفاده می‌کرد. تروبات، که شیفته ماهیت زودگذر رقص است، هدف خود را حفظ زیبایی زودگذر آن از طریق این نوآوری‌های تکنولوژیکی قرار داده است.

article_content: Royal Ascot's second day showcased stylish attire, with bold blooms, chic black and white, and striking floral prints vying for attention. The spectacularly large hats were particularly eye-catching, even surpassing the vibrant floral prints. The Queen wore a mint green, purple, and pale pink Angela Kelly creation, complemented by a mint green crepe coat and a multi-colored floral silk dress by Peter Enrione, and a diamond and emerald brooch. She appeared in high spirits, accompanied by Prince Charles and the Duchess of Cornwall. However, not all attendees had a positive experience. Besides bookmakers facing payouts on multiple colors for the second consecutive day, racegoer Tracey Rose was ejected from the Royal Enclosure due to a dress code violation. Her skirt was deemed too short, prompting her to criticize the Ascot staff as 'rude' and the decision as 'preposterous'. Another milliner, David Schilling, was also ejected for inappropriate headgear—a large floral wreath hidden under his top hat. In contrast, the Duchess of Cornwall's cream hat and pea green coat, paired with a floral dress, were deemed stylish. The Countess of Wessex also made an appearance, wearing a nude and cerise straw hat with a knee-length wrap dress. Lady Helen Taylor opted for a vibrant violet and yellow dress with a turquoise hat, while Viscountess Serena Linley favored elegant neutrals. Denise Lewis looked stunning in a black and white ensemble. The day included various fashion choices, from monochrome to bright colors, large hats, and floral prints. Bookmaker Coral's odds on the Queen's hat color for Ladies' Day (the following day) are mentioned. The article also includes descriptions of other attendees' outfits and a summary of the Ascot dress code.
translated_content: روز دوم رویال آسکوت با لباس‌های شیک و جذاب آغاز شد، با گل‌های جسورانه، لباس‌های شیک سیاه و سفید و چاپ‌های گلدار خیره‌کننده که همگی برای برتری در سبک رقابت می‌کردند. کلاه‌های بزرگ و تماشایی به‌طور ویژه‌ای چشم‌نواز بودند و حتی از چاپ‌های گلدار زنده‌تر هم جلوه می‌کردند. ملکه لباسی از آنجلا کلی با رنگ‌های سبز نعنائی، بنفش و صورتی کم‌رنگ پوشیده بود که با کت کرپ سبز نعنائی و لباس ابریشمی گلدار چند رنگ پیتر انریونه و یک سینه سنجاق الماس و زمردی تکمیل شده بود. او با نشاط و در کنار شاهزاده چارلز و دوشس کورنوال حضور داشت. با این حال، همه از این روز لذت نبردند. علاوه بر شرط‌بندی‌کنندگانی که مجبور به پرداخت وجه برای رنگ‌های مختلف در روز دوم متوالی بودند، تِرِیسی روز، به دلیل نقض قوانین لباس از محوطه‌ی رویال آسکوت اخراج شد. دامن او خیلی کوتاه ارزیابی شد و باعث شد که او از کارکنان آسکوت به عنوان ‘بی‌ادب’ و تصمیم را ‘پوچ’ بنامد.  یک کلاهساز دیگر، دیوید شیلینگ، نیز به دلیل پوشش نامناسب سر—یک تاج گل بزرگ پنهان شده زیر کلاهش—اخراج شد. در مقابل، کلاه کرم رنگ و کت سبز نخودی دوشس کورنوال، همراه با لباس گلدار، شیک ارزیابی شد. کنتس وسکس نیز با پوشیدن کلاه حصیری برهنه و قرمز روشن با یک لباس بلند تا زانو حضور یافت. لیدی هلن تیلور لباس بنفش و زرد رنگ شادابی با کلاه فیروزه‌ای انتخاب کرد، در حالی که ویسکانتس سرنا لینلی لباس‌های خنثی و ظریف را ترجیح داد. دنیس لوئیس در لباس سیاه و سفید خیره‌کننده به نظر می‌رسید. این روز شامل انتخاب‌های مختلف مد، از تک رنگ تا رنگ‌های روشن، کلاه‌های بزرگ و چاپ‌های گلدار بود. ضرایب شرط‌بندی شرکت Coral در مورد رنگ کلاه ملکه برای روز بانوان (روز بعد) ذکر شده است. این مقاله شامل شرح لباس‌های سایر شرکت‌کنندگان و خلاصه‌ای از قوانین لباس آسکوت نیز هست.

article_content: Police investigating the disappearance of three Michigan brothers say the boys' father, John Skelton, has no established relationship with the woman he claims to have left them with. Skelton told authorities he left his sons, Tanner (5), Alexander (7), and Andrew (9), with a woman identified only as Joann Taylor on Friday morning before attempting suicide.  He said this was done to prevent the children from witnessing his act. While Skelton's suicide attempt failed, and he's currently in a mental health facility, police have found no evidence of Taylor.  Chief Larry Weeks of the Morenci Police Department stated there's no record of this woman.  Police are also seeking information about Skelton's blue 2000 Dodge Caravan, believed to have transported the boys between Thursday afternoon and Friday. Skelton claimed Taylor was to take the boys to their Morenci home around 3 p.m. Friday; however, the boys never arrived. An Amber Alert was issued on Friday. The last known sighting of the boys by a non-family member was Thursday at 5 p.m.  Authorities are urging the public to provide any information, no matter how insignificant it may seem.  Family spokeswoman Kathye Herrera expressed the family's hope for the boys' safe return.
translated_content: پلیس در حال بررسی ناپدید شدن سه برادر اهل میشیگان است. آن‌ها می‌گویند پدر این بچه‌ها، جان اسکلتون، هیچ ارتباطی با زنی که ادعا می‌کند فرزندانش را به او سپرده، ندارد. اسکلتون به مقامات گفته که صبح جمعه پسرانش، تینر (5 ساله)، الکساندر (7 ساله) و اندرو (9 ساله) را پیش زنی به نام جوان تیلور گذاشته است، قبل از اینکه تلاش ناموفقی برای خودکشی داشته باشد. او گفت که این کار را کرده تا فرزندانش شاهد خودکشی او نباشند. با وجود اینکه تلاش برای خودکشی اسکلتون ناموفق بوده و او در حال حاضر در یک مرکز روانپزشکی به سر می‌برد، اما پلیس هیچ مدرکی دال بر وجود چنین زنی پیدا نکرده است. رئیس پلیس مورنسی، لری ویکس، تأیید کرد که هیچ سوابقی از این زن وجود ندارد. پلیس همچنین به دنبال اطلاعاتی در مورد ون آبی رنگ دوج 2000 اسکلتون است که گمان می‌رود پسران را بین پنجشنبه بعدازظهر تا جمعه جابجا کرده باشد. اسکلتون ادعا کرده که تیلور قرار بوده پسران را حدود ساعت 3 بعدازظهر جمعه به خانه‌شان در مورنسی برساند؛ اما، پسران هرگز به خانه نرسیدند. هشدار آمبر روز جمعه صادر شد. آخرین بار که این پسران توسط فردی غیر از اعضای خانواده دیده شدند، ساعت 5 عصر پنجشنبه بوده است. مقامات از عموم مردم درخواست کرده‌اند که هرگونه اطلاعاتی، مهم نیست چقدر جزئی به نظر می‌رسد، در اختیار آن‌ها قرار دهند. کتی هررا، سخنگوی خانواده، امید خود را برای بازگشت سالم پسران ابراز کرده است.
